reviews.comment:
Están sobre una ruta de viajeros nacionales y extranjeros y NO ACEPTA TARJETAS De CRÉDITO ni DÉBITO... Una vergüenza... Pero si tienen posnet para servicio. En los sanitarios no había agua y en el bar cobran carísimo las bebidas y comidas... No se merece el cartel de ACA.

(Translated by Google)
They're located on a route frequented by both domestic and international travelers and they DON'T ACCEPT CREDIT OR DEBIT CARDS... A disgrace... But they do have a card reader for service. There was no water in the restrooms and the drinks and food at the bar are outrageously expensive... They don't deserve the ACA sign.

reviews.comment:
1,30 horas esperando para cargar combustibles, porque no tienen descarga a distancia, y estaban recibiendo camión. Después que empezaron a despachar,  un solo playero, el otro adentro de la oficina, y lamentablemente es la única estación ya que no hay ninguna dentro de ita ibate

(Translated by Google)
I waited 1.5 hours to get fuel because they don't have remote unloading, and they were receiving a truck. After they started dispensing, there was only one attendant, the other was inside the office, and unfortunately, it's the only station since there aren't any within Ita Ibate.
